accomplishments.text: Launched the Mission Control dashboard with a nightly scheduled sync that moves daily updates from the form queue to GitHub, summarizes them onto member pages, and now also logs each update to the club-wide technical log Google Sheet.
Settled the starter board's power design: USB-C carries data only (DFU and log download), and the 1S LiPo powers all logic.

Replaced 3 out-of-stock parts during design: IMU LSM6DSO32 → LSM6DSV32X (same ±32 g range and package, new register map), 10 µF capacitor 0805 → 0603, 100 kΩ resistor 0603 → 0402; moved the parts list from PDF to Markdown.
Removed GPS from v1 of the starter board and updated the lessons and parts list to match.
Published the Starter Flight Computer parts list and Lessons 1–3 for the new-member practice board.

data.focus: Extending the Mission Control dashboard and scoping airbrakes sensing and simulation with Controls. On Nov 16 he went through the controls requirements with Nathan Aldridge and Caleb to inform the flight computer architecture choice.

data.focus: Defining the IMU for the avionics sensor suite. On Nov 18 he met with Caleb to pin down Caleb's IMU configuration needs and timelines, then researched the BMI270's required support circuitry and pin layout. He settled on the BMI270 as the team's IMU (two units needed). Next he will finish working out the BMI270 pinout and circuit and pick a magnetometer and barometer for the suite.

accomplishments.text: Added the SWD debug/programming header and a MOSFET-driven buzzer circuit to the L1 STM32 board schematic.

data.focus: Designing the schematic for the L1 STM32 flight board, with pyro channels up next. On 2026-11-17 he finished the debug/programming section: a 10-pin 1.27 mm SWD header (Samtec FTSH-105-01) breaking out 3V3, SWDIO, SWCLK, SWO and NRST. He also completed the buzzer circuit, driving a CSS-J4B20 buzzer off 3V3 through an AO3400A N-MOSFET from a BUZZER_PWM line, with a 10k gate pull-down and a 1N4148W flyback diode. Next he is adding the pyro circuits and updating footprints.
